title: After Effects hosting
stmt: Host AE effects, suites, Panelator panels and AEIO; GPU frames on shared textures.

title: Arenas and sealed segments
stmt: Per media-instance shm arena, RGBA16F default; idle windows unmapped at 30 s; host creates, sizes and seals segments and copies out before reading: no SIGBUS, no TOCTOU.

title: Author tooling and debugging
stmt: Authors use craft-ext new, build, migrate, dev --watch, test, run, bench, replay, lint, lint-docs, pack, sign, submit, doctor, docs; LLDB-friendly worker builds, DAP server for JS and a UI-tree inspector.

title: batched-edits
stmt: Plugins issue thousands of dependent edits in one batch with step references, one IPC and one undo step

title: bridge-all-commands
stmt: Plugins call any plugin-visible app command through app.run and app.batch under derived permissions

title: Host brokers
stmt: Files, processes, OS opens and clipboard only through brokers.

title: Single budget table
stmt: BUDGETS and GPU_BUDGETS hold every budget number (in platform.lock.json); docs name CallClasses, never numbers.

title: Budgets and rails
stmt: Per-plugin accounts, quarantine, Stop-all, safe mode.

title: canonical-ops
stmt: Plugins edit any app through 87 portable canonical ops

title: CLI plugin management
stmt: Every app offers <app> plugins ... through ext-cli; headless runs never prompt and widening requires --approve-widening on a TTY.

title: Clipboard access
stmt: clipboard.read {types} accepts any MIME type or UTI and returns {type, data: Handle(Bytes)}; clipboard.types lists formats; clipboard.write {items} accepts any type incl. application/vnd.<plugin-id>.*, public.svg-image, com.adobe.pdf and application/vnd.adobe.*; craft/<app>-native is still parsed as untrusted input on paste; 256 MiB per item; clipboard.monitor (L2) and clipboard.watch for automatic reads.

title: command-interception-override
stmt: Users let plugins intercept or override interceptable and overridable commands with fail-open timing

title: Companion controllers
stmt: Stream Deck class controllers without IP.

title: Compat: cep-compat CSInterface mapping
stmt: cep-compat maps evalScript to the package's extendscript@1 engine; CSEvent addEventListener and dispatchEvent to bus.subscribe and bus.publish on declared topics, other events to events.subscribe; openURLInDefaultBrowser to ui.open_url (gesture plus sheet, else -2); CEP panels are T6 pages; big typed arrays move as Handle(Bytes); UXP userInfo.userId maps to host.installId {scope: plugin} with its [licensing] table.

title: Compat: E4X support
stmt: XML and XMLList literals, .@attr, ..descendant, .(filter), default xml namespace and for each...in run through a Rust XML DOM runtime instead of failing.

title: Compat: jsxbin acceptance
stmt: extendscript@1 and photoshop.jsx@1 accept .jsxbin wherever .jsx is accepted (user runs, package scripts, #include, $.evalFile, eval of a jsxbin string), with decoded ASTs cached by sha256.

title: Compat: Node proxy mirror
stmt: Node proxies read a worker-side columnar mirror keyed by node id and field group, prefetched with one node.get per event and invalidated by document.changed. Own writes update written fields in place and mark host-derived groups (layout x/y, absoluteBoundingBox, text auto-resize size, fillGeometry) dirty; reading a dirty group flushes the cx.edit batch and refetches it in one IPC.

title: Compat: Incumbent API mapping
stmt: figma-compat, photoshop-uxp, extendscript@1 and photoshop.jsx@1 map app.refresh, waitForRedraw and core.redrawDocument to view.refresh, executeAsModal to txn.modal, ScriptUI palettes and UXP floating panels to palette windows and app.preferences reads to app.preferences.get; ScriptUI converts to UI 1.3 via ext-js/scriptui.

title: JS compat shims
stmt: Plugins use figma-compat, photoshop-uxp, uxp-page, photoshop.jsx@1, cep-compat and node-compat shims and craft-ext import for UXP, CEP/.zxp and Figma.

title: Per-OS confinement
stmt: One normative profile set per OS.

title: Contract compatibility rule
stmt: Compatibility stays as ext-core::contract decides: same major, provided minor at least the needed minor; two majors may be provided side by side during a migration.

title: Command, menu, palette, toolbar
stmt: Plugins contribute a command with [contribution.command]; Event::Command.

title: Context menu
stmt: Plugins contribute a command with context:<target> paths; targets per app; all apps.

title: Contract-backed contribution kinds
stmt: Manifest kinds that run on their contract: effect, transition, generator, brush engine, audio, ease, deformer, format IO, hook, service, input filter, lane, node, vector effect, viewport pass, web window, data.

title: Inspector section
stmt: Plugins contribute a inspector with target and order.

title: Notifications
stmt: ui.notify {text, kind, actions, os} shows attributed toasts; os:true in background also posts an OS notification whose click delivers notify.clicked; the host notifies when a background job, export or modal over 10 s ends.

title: Canvas or viewport overlay
stmt: Plugins contribute a overlay with T2 layers and regions in document or world space.

title: Panel contribution
stmt: Plugins contribute a panel using ui.surface.*, ui.patch, ui.values.set; all apps.

title: Row decoration
stmt: Plugins contribute a row-decoration.

title: Settings page
stmt: Plugins contribute a settings generated from [settings] or a T1 tree.

title: Start card
stmt: Plugins contribute a start-card as a T1 card on the app's start page.

title: Status item
stmt: Plugins contribute a status item as a limited T1 subtree in the status bar.

title: Tool
stmt: Plugins contribute a tool with icon, group, cursor, options form, pen=true.

title: Window, dialog, popover, HUD
stmt: Plugins contribute a window and dialog kinds (or runtime only) per section 11.4.

title: JavaScript DAP debugging
stmt: craft-ext dev runs a DAP server over the console channel with breakpoints, conditional breakpoints, stepping, watch, call stacks with source maps, exception pause and live eval in the paused frame (V8 inspector, QuickJS hooks); VS Code and Zed attach.

title: Host-call log recording
stmt: Every session can record a host-call log for craft-ext replay.

title: Debug this plugin
stmt: Manager toggle restarts at Dev confinement.

title: T1/T2 tree inspector
stmt: craft-ext dev opens a UI-tree inspector with live tree, keys, styles, bindings, value store, patch history with revisions, hit-region overlay and access-tree view; T6 pages get a CEF DevTools window (network always empty).

title: Wasm source-level debugging
stmt: Dev and Local workers start with Wasmtime debug_info(true) and a debuggable entitlement so LLDB attaches to craft-plugin-worker with source-level stepping for Rust, C and Zig.

title: Deckhand features
stmt: Controller keys and dials run commands and scrub values in all three apps; key images show live state.
detail: devices.companion with a pinned vendor app; frames as automatic events; device: chords run as user-invoked; schema-checked key images; plugins.run.

title: Derived determinism
stmt: Host derives the class from the exec path (exact, seeded, tolerant, stateful) and records it in plugins.lock.

title: Dev console
stmt: Dev and Local tiers (and any tier on request from the manager) get a per-call log with op, permission, duration, bytes, IPC time, GPU timings per pass, memory and GPU account, UI patch rate, strikes, ladder rungs and probation state per digest.

title: Device brokers
stmt: MIDI, HID, serial, gamepad, USB/PTP/scan and companion devices via brokers under devices.*; worker gets per-session descriptors; no network endpoints (DEC-COM-midi-usb-no-network).

title: Device loss recovery without closing
stmt: LossRecovery rebuilds device, pools and pipelines while the app keeps documents in memory: egui apps swap the renderer through Painter::recreate_device behind an ArcSwap; EffectCraft rebuilds wgpu device, Gpu and pipelines keeping Session instead of closing; PhotoCraft re-requests the device and rebuilds gpu_canvas returning from CPU mode; FigCraft rebuilds the job device and canvas renderer.
detail: Also: the journal digest is kill-listed, the frame re-renders without that plugin with a badge and the package records a loss.

title: Drag and drop between plugin and host
stmt: UI nodes declare drag {kind, payload} and drop {accept}; host kinds craft/layer-ref, color, asset-handle, node-ref, file-handle, media, text/plain, files; plugin kinds plugin/<id>/<kind>. OS drops arrive as handles; drag-out writes a host temp file with the origin mark.
detail: file-handle and media kinds import into project, timeline or canvas in every app; a plugin kind on a drop_targets target sends drop {target, area, at, items} to its plugin, user-invoked; one undo step per drop.

title: Durable outputs
stmt: Results stored with plugin, version, digest and params at user-chosen resolution; a missing plugin renders them badged.

title: Engine configuration
stmt: Cranelift AOT at prepare; HMAC-tagged cache keyed by module sha256, engine config and CPU features, re-prepared on mismatch, never struck; epochs 1 ms (0.25 ms audio); SIMD128; relaxed SIMD only when tolerant; no WASI files or sockets.

title: Everything is charged
stmt: Every host allocation for a plugin goes through account::charge; ChargeKind is plugin CPU, GPU or disk (-6 at cap), or spillable or reclaimable app cache.
detail: Plugin: RSS, arenas, instances, caches, handles, frames, doc.scratch, job tiles, model dirty pages, GPU resources, storage, durable outputs. Spillable: staging, readbacks, filter outputs, DocGrowth. Reclaimable: clean model pages, FileSnapshots.

title: Eviction ladder
stmt: Rungs in order: spill SpillableAppCache to app scratch; evict plugin caches above floors; suspend idle instances; drop persistent GPU targets; checkpoint SimCache to disk; then -6 GlobalCap only when RAM and scratch are full. App caches are never evicted; OS pressure runs the same ladder.

title: Plugin platform in every other Craft app
stmt: FilmCraft, AniCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft, LightCraft, TextureCraft, MaterialCraft and SoundCraft run the plugin platform through their own adapters.

title: Fonts and text services
stmt: Package fonts usable in plugin UI immediately (font = pkg:Inter) and in documents.

title: Full-mode residual table
stmt: threat-map.toml lists residual reach; O4b checks it.

title: Background GPU share
stmt: Background GPU gets 25% of frame time interactive, 100% idle, per adapter suite-wide; tiles sized to GpuSubmit; 4x overruns halve tiles or demote.

title: Headless GPU CI
stmt: CI on lavapipe, WARP and Metal; goldens within class tolerance.

title: Derived GPU needs
stmt: craft-ext derives features, limits and worst-case GpuCost from naga IR into craft.lock; data-dependent loops are Unbounded; unmet needs return -8.

title: GPU errors attributed
stmt: Only DeviceBroker installs error callbacks; plugin errors are attributed by the journal; apps see only unattributed ones via health().

title: GT3 command set
stmt: GT3 covers the wgpu 30 encoder: resources, queries, BLAS/TLAS, compute and render passes, MSAA, indirect, ray tracing, bundles.

title: GT3 rules
stmt: Per-plugin generational handles; app textures read-only; pipelines LRU 512 per package; promoted lists inline within GpuSubmit, others on probation.

title: GT3 validator
stmt: validate checks the copied list: formats, ranges, views, draws, viewport, resolves, queries, BLAS/TLAS, quota, debug groups.

title: Cross-process loss recovery
stmt: On adapter reset the broker fans out gpu.reset; helpers recreate devices; shared textures and fences re-export.

title: Open GPU features
stmt: craft-gpu requests every adapter feature and limit, clamped by quota, reported in host.info.gpu.

title: GPU probation and promotion
stmt: A digest promotes at validation when its bounded GpuCost fits GpuSubmit, or after 120 clean frames within it; Unbounded never promotes. Unpromoted work runs on the probation device, never on the app queue; a watchdog strike demotes.

title: GPU-resident cache
stmt: Meshes, textures and flow fields stay on the GPU across frames, threads and instances.

title: GPU validation
stmt: naga validates every module (0.08 ms); only WGSL; ShaderRuntimeChecks::checked() bounds every storage and texture access; trusted and passthrough modules only in craft-gpu (lint); probe compiles on D3D12 and Vulkan; kill lists checked.

title: Watchdog and submit journal
stmt: Work pending 1 s interactive or 10 s export strikes its digest; {package, digest} is journalled before each submit; a per-adapter broker journal attributes resets across helpers and CEF pages.

title: Handle table
stmt: Handles are u32 index plus generation per plugin; they die with their scope or device generation.

title: Hardware devices
stmt: MIDI, HID, serial, USB, PTP, scanners via brokers.

title: Heavy commands run off owner thread
stmt: Commands whose calibrated cost exceeds OwnerFrame run off the owner thread through gate step 11; RunMode::Long commands (content-aware fill, actions.play, EffectCraft long jobs) called inside an open txn or txn.modal run there into that TxnLog as one history step with progress and cancel, and job.runCommand stays for detached work.

title: Run without plugin checks
stmt: Users bypass behaviour hooks via Save, Export or Render without plugin checks.

title: Host codecs
stmt: Image, RAW, PSD, EXR, HEIC, DDS/KTX2, video, GIF and PDF codecs run in craft-media-decode per codec-services@1.

title: iOS builds of the three apps with in-process wasmi plugins
stmt: The three apps ship iOS builds that run plugins interpreted in-process on wasmi, JavaScript as quickjs.wasm inside wasmi, under ext-engine::inproc containment (fuel, memory cap, bounded stacks, contain, Stop-all) and the same gate.

title: Keycast features
stmt: Overlay of keystrokes, shortcuts with command names, clicks and clipboard actions across all programs while recording; presets, per-program filters, pause key.
detail: input.monitor via craft-input-monitor; click-through overlay window; clipboard.monitor types and sizes; app.events:command names.

title: Kiln features
stmt: Sends the selection to the user's Blender, where a packaged add-on builds the scene; renders, bakes and camera moves return as footage, layers or fills; Blender's viewport mirrors in a docked panel.
detail: process.run:blender (full, picked, pinned) with an exchange folder; native.full helper kiln-live presents Blender's shared GPU frames as a T5a surface; job.spawn renders; media.decode.

title: Licence SDK
stmt: Offline request codes and signed licence files.

title: Live collaboration writes
stmt: Live writes under collab.write and presence under collab.presence, requested per package; the server checks, stamps, meters and elects runners per CON-COM-collab-live-write@1.

title: Localisation
stmt: Fluent files in locales/; {t:key,args} wherever text is accepted.

title: Manifest schema 3
stmt: Unknown keys refused with fix-its.

title: Menus only in extension groups
stmt: Menus go only into host-declared extension groups.

title: Placeholder for missing plugin panels
stmt: Layouts referencing missing plugins keep the slot hidden through reconcile and show.

title: MockHost simulate faults
stmt: MockHost supports simulate.userGesture, revoke, deviceLoss, slow, userEditBetweenSlices, foreignWrite {principal}, suspend, engineBump and memoryPressure.

title: Modal transactions
stmt: Plugins open modal scopes via txn.modal {label, interactive, cancellable}, SDK craft::txn::modal or JS core.executeAsModal: one undo step, no wall-clock deadline, host progress bar with Cancel and Esc, other principals' edits queue, and other documents, saving and quit never block.

title: Store and model packages
stmt: Verified packages, quarantine, rollback, model parts.

title: Model weights reclaimable
stmt: Mapped model pages are charged per everything-is-charged; the sheet offers a one-tap raise.

title: One package, several apps
stmt: [apps] lists apps and minimum <app>.session level (optional=true apps may be missing); portable-contract contributions work in every listed app that provides them with Compat::Partly listing gaps; app-specific code uses generated modules whose current() returns None elsewhere; host.capabilities and host.apiLevel(app) let a plugin degrade, SDK errors name the missing contract or op.

title: Native helpers
stmt: Plugins call their native helpers from Wasm and JS with zero-copy pixel and texture handles.

title: Native SIMD kernels
stmt: kernel.* run in the worker over arena views on AVX-512, AVX2 or NEON with no app hop.

title: Inference backends
stmt: Backends candle, wgsl, onnx (tract or candle-onnx), coreml and ort (CoreML, DirectML, CUDA), placed per DEC-COM-ai-backends; the first available in the manifest list wins.

title: Model store
stmt: Models come packaged, as catalogue packages or user-picked, sha256-checked into one mapped suite store; no plugin fetches.

title: Render-path inference
stmt: nn.infer runs inside RenderHook on its backend, waits only within the remaining budget, else takes the preview ladder.
budget: RenderHook remaining; helper kill drops 0 frames

title: Zero-copy tensors
stmt: CPU tensors are shm views; GPU tensors stay on their adapter; nn.fromImage and nn.toImage are zero-copy or one GPU pass; Bind::Tensor binds into GT2 and GT3; CPU tract on a GPU-resident input costs one readback and one upload inside RenderHook.
budget: GPU and ANE backends 0 CPU readbacks

title: node-compat: child_process maps to process.run
stmt: @craft/node-compat child_process maps to process.run {decl, argv, stdin, files, cwd}: spawn and execFile match a declared, identity-pinned executable; exec with shell syntax uses the [[process]] shell form (CON-COM-manifest.process); stdio are rings; fork(modulePath) starts a package JS module as job.spawn with a message channel.

title: node-compat: crypto runs in JS
stmt: @craft/node-compat crypto runs in JS: hashes, HMAC and ciphers in JS and randomBytes from the worker's RNG.

title: node-compat: fs and fs/promises map to file and folder ops
stmt: @craft/node-compat fs and fs/promises map to file and folder ops: file.read {path, range}, file.write, file.stat, file.rename, folder.list, folder.create, folder.watch (files.watch) and file.remove {permanent: true} (needs the files.write root, else trash with a log line); fds are broker handle ids, streams ride rings, and chmod with an execute bit returns EACCES from -2 (security P6).

title: node-compat: http, https, http2, net, tls, dgram and dns throw Excluded
stmt: @craft/node-compat http, https, http2, net, tls, dgram and dns throw Excluded: Error with code -9 (Excluded).

title: node-compat: os maps to host.info and real paths
stmt: @craft/node-compat os maps to host.info and real paths: platform, arch, release, EOL, cpus, totalmem and freemem from host.info; homedir and tmpdir return real paths under files.paths (tmpdir is the plugin temp folder) else ~ tokens the shim resolves; networkInterfaces() returns {}.

title: node-compat: process object
stmt: @craft/node-compat process object: platform, arch, env (declared variables only), cwd() (plugin data folder), argv, exit() (ends the run) and nextTick.

title: node-compat: path, url, querystring, util, events, buffer, string_decoder, stream, assert
stmt: @craft/node-compat path, url, querystring, util, events, buffer, string_decoder, stream, assert and timers are pure JS: setTimeout and setInterval on timer.*.

title: OFX hosting
stmt: Host OFX effects: every context, action and suite, all GPU APIs.

title: One ladder
stmt: render::Ladder alone picks degrade rungs and badges, returning a RenderDecision; apps hold no ladder state.

title: package-assets-as-files
stmt: Plugins pass packaged templates, footage, brushes, LUTs and fonts to app commands without copying or grants

title: Tile parallelism
stmt: threads = tiles bands one export over N instances; threads = shared allows Wasm threads within the cap.

title: Per-plugin GPU accounts
stmt: Default quotas; a sheet-shown quota_mb applies at enable; a one-tap Allow raises it within the suite cap.

title: GPU state across loss
stmt: Loss bumps the generation (old handles -3) and sends gpu.lost; gpu::Persistent and SimCache restore.

title: Keep-alive and suspend
stmt: keep_alive 60s or session; suspend allows 50 ms for state.save, resume returns it; index.bin starts without manifests.

title: Plugin manager
stmt: Window > Plugins in every app with Installed, Discover, Updates, Activity, Problems, Settings and per-plugin pages; reports exclude plugin text.

title: Plugin services, bus and plugins.run
stmt: Plugins call other plugins' services, publish on a bus within an app or across the suite, and run other plugins' commands through plugins.run under confused-deputy rules.

title: Preferences read
stmt: app.preferences.get {group, keys?} and bridged PrefsRead commands are free; DECIDED 8 groups and Endpoint/Secret keys return '<redacted>'.

title: Unknown data kept
stmt: craft-preserve keeps unknown plugin data byte-identical.

title: Prism features
stmt: Gradient maps, split toning, looks and LUT export as EffectCraft effects, PhotoCraft filters and FigCraft fills, native and web.
detail: One raster.filter@2 contribution, exec gpu.kernel and wasm; looks as resource.lut@1; LUT export via files.write:picked; Wasm on the ext-worker web backend.

title: Provider hooks
stmt: Plugins contribute candidate sets.

title: Native hosts in public releases
stmt: Beta builds ship craft-pshost, craft-aehost and the OFX bridge; public releases per D-K.

title: QoS per class
stmt: qos.rs maps classes to OS priority from real-time audio to BACKGROUND jobs; Linux never raises priority.

title: QuickJS on web, iOS
stmt: JS on web and iOS runs on quickjs.wasm with bytecode cached at prepare.

title: Real-time audio class
stmt: Audio slots run on a real-time worker thread (os_workgroup, MMCSS Pro Audio, rtkit, else nice 0 with notice); arenas mlocked; no growth or allocating calls while armed; 0.25 ms epochs; 128-frame deadline.

title: Relay features
stmt: FigCraft vectors and PhotoCraft layers to EffectCraft layers and EffectCraft frames back, offline on one machine; a chip imports SVG or PDF vectors other programs copy.
detail: bus.publish reach suite carries CBOR <=64 KiB; frames and larger paths go as ext-shm lend_readonly handles named in the payload, 0 encodes; service.call over broker IPC; clipboard.read on click; clipboard.monitor types only.

title: Render permit leases
stmt: A suite semaphore holds max(apps, cores minus app render threads) render permits, at least one per app; a blocked app render thread lends its permit; brokers lease {pid, tid, call_seq, deadline}, reclaimed at deadline, exit or two missed heartbeats.

title: Sandbox self-test
stmt: Every confined start self-tests its profile and fails closed.

title: scratch-documents
stmt: Plugins create ephemeral scratch documents, edit them freely and render them

title: Scratch what-if renders and atomic save
stmt: Plugins run what-if renders on doc.scratch forks leaving no trace, open packages in one step and save through the atomic save protocol.

title: AssemblyScript SDK
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: sdk/as/assembly/craft/*.ts with classes and a CBOR codec compiled by asc.

title: SDK: fx::iter and photo::pixels band iterators
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: craft::fx::iter and craft::photo::pixels iterate bands over SIMD128 lanes unrolled by 4, amortising the per-back-edge epoch check.

title: bindgen --check and zero-copy media hot paths
stmt: bindgen --check in CI fails when generated files differ from the locks; media hot paths are identical in every language (views and rings are raw memory, C, Zig and AssemblyScript read pixels directly, JS engines get typed arrays over the arena without copies).
budget: 0 copies between arena and guest view in every language; 4K RGBA16F frame visible to the guest <= 50 us

title: C SDK
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: sdk/c/include/craft headers with structs, enums, call wrappers and a tiny CBOR writer and reader in craft.c, built by wasi-sdk clang to wasm32-unknown-unknown.

title: SDK: cx.edit batching
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: cx.edit batches writes into one app.batch with step references for ids created earlier (Pending ids), splits for size limits, read-your-writes overlay and retries once on -4 by re-reading.

title: SDK: cx.group undo grouping
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: cx.group(label, closure) makes one undo step across events, auto-closed at gesture end or 60 s.

title: Generated API docs
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: docs/plugins/api/<app>.md (with command id to permission table) and platform.md, one section per op with schema, permission, contexts and example.

title: SDK: gpu::Persistent<T>
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: gpu::Persistent<T> re-creates GPU resources and re-runs initialisers on gpu.lost.

title: Plugin languages
stmt: Plugins are authored in Rust, C, Zig, AssemblyScript and TypeScript/JS with craft.js and swc-based bundling; WIT may describe plugin contracts and ext-bindgen generates the same bindings from it.

title: SDK: craft::licence
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: craft::licence::{request_code, verify} do offline activation over host.installId and an ed25519 vendor key.

title: MCP tool schemas
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: Tool schemas and read-only and destructive hints from the same Meta for each app's MCP server.

title: SDK: native helper RPC wrappers
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: native::{start, call, ring, stop} and craft_native::serve wrap helper RPC with views and textures passed by handle.

title: Rust SDK
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: craft-guest/src/gen/{platform,canonical,apps/<app>}.rs with typed CBOR params and results, op functions, event enums and entry macros (filter!, session!, service!, node!, tool!, audio_effect!).

title: SDK: craft::state session state
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: craft::state::{save, load} keep session state across suspension; SDK panels save their value store automatically.

title: SDK: craft::text shaping
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: craft::text::{shape, outlines, subset} wrap font.shape, font.bytes and guest-side subsetting for embedding exporters.

title: TypeScript and JavaScript SDK
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: sdk/js/craft.d.ts and craft.js; craft-ext build strips types with swc (no Node) and bundles imports into js/*.js with source maps; package ships source and code caches are produced at prepare per engine; V8 in the worker, QuickJS on web and iOS.

title: SDK: craft::txn::modal
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: craft::txn::modal and core.executeAsModal give a modal scope with automatic heartbeat from gated calls.

title: SDK: Typed errors
stmt: SDK behaviour identical in every language: OpError {code, name, detail, needs} from section 7.5 in every language.

title: Zig SDK
stmt: Generated by ext-bindgen: sdk/zig/craft/*.zig generated from the same schema for wasm32-freestanding.

title: session-state
stmt: Plugins save session state up to 16 MiB that survives worker suspension and restart

title: Plugin settings
stmt: Schema-declared settings.* build Preferences > Plugins; 1 MiB.

title: Shortcut chords and modes
stmt: keys=[{chord, mode press|hold|toggle}]; chords may use any key, Mouse3-Mouse8, Pen1.

title: Device chords bound only by the user
stmt: Device chords device:<companion id>/<control> bind only when the user creates them.

title: Storage and document data
stmt: Per-plugin key-value and blob storage, [share] keys, and document data in private, shared or instance namespaces.

title: Suite ledger
stmt: A shared segment totals plugin CPU, GPU and background GPU per app; over a cap the ladder runs across apps.

title: Cross-app suite reach
stmt: bus.publish {reach: suite} and service.call {app} reach the same plugin id's workers or a declared service/bus provider in other running ArtCraft apps of the user session, over host IPC with no network.

title: App-modal dialog surface
stmt: Dialog via ui.dialog.open, app-modal over the document; nested modals stack as children of the plugin's topmost to the ui.surface-limits@1 depth; closed by the user, the plugin or Stop-all; no grant.

title: Edit keys in focused surfaces
stmt: A surface declares handles of undo, redo, copy, cut, paste, delete, selectAll.

title: Modal, fullscreen, topmost, overlay
stmt: window level modal|fullscreen|topmost|overlay: modal over other plugins.

title: Floating OS window surface
stmt: window kind floating is a real OS window via craft-libs window.

title: HUD overlay surface
stmt: HUD via ui.hud.open {anchor canvas|viewport|pointer, offset}

title: Palette window surface
stmt: Palette windows (ui.window.open kind palette and every visible ui.web page) need no grant: above document windows after a click, never above other apps, hidden while inactive, frame saved and clamped.

title: Docking panel surface
stmt: A panel opened from the Window menu, a command or ui.surface.open docks through craft-libs docking with reconcile and placeholders, tears off and back, and needs no grant.

title: Anchored popover surface
stmt: Popover via ui.popover.open anchored to a plugin node or canvas region.

title: Window options and focus rule
stmt: Size hints, min/max size, resizable, frameless.

title: T6 camera and mic
stmt: getUserMedia through the capture broker.

title: T6 clipboard
stmt: Clipboard APIs through the broker on activation.

title: T6 schemes
stmt: craft-pkg and craft-picked only.

title: T6 inspector
stmt: DevTools window for Dev and Local tiers.

title: Web docking modes
stmt: CefDocked (web-mode@1) docks, tabs and collapses every T6 panel as a shared-texture surface clipped by the dock; every mode is built and tested.

title: T6 files in and out
stmt: Downloads, file inputs, drops and drags via host sheets and handles.

title: T6 WebGL and WebGPU
stmt: Enabled; GPU process confined and charged.

title: T6 hidden pages
stmt: Headless compute pages outside render.

title: Port UXP or CEP panel to T1

title: Text shaping

title: Tooling: craft-ext build
stmt: Authors get compiles, bundles JS with source maps, validates WGSL for its tier, derives GPU features, limits, binding sizes and splittable from IR and DAG, refreshes craft.lock.

title: Tooling: craft-ext dev
stmt: Authors get installs as Dev tier into a running app, hot-reloads keeping panel state and value store, re-validates shaders, streams the console.

title: Tooling: craft-ext doctor
stmt: Authors get explains why a plugin is unavailable in an app (contract, permission, GPU feature, quarantine, policy).

title: Tooling: craft-ext lint
stmt: Authors get strict manifest parse, permission minimality, contribution limits, string sanitising, GPU needs and memory overrides differing from derived or observed values.

title: Tooling: craft-ext lint-docs
stmt: Authors get parses every backticked permission, op, error code and manifest key and every toml block in docs/plugins and app documents against platform.lock.json (gate C20).

title: Tooling: craft-ext migrate
stmt: Authors get rewrites schema 1 and 2 manifests to schema 3.

title: Tooling: craft-ext new
stmt: Authors get template per contribution kind (--lang rust|c|zig|as|ts|js) with a passing test.

title: Tooling: craft-ext pack, sign, submit

title: Tooling: craft-ext replay

title: Tooling: craft-ext run

title: Tooling: craft-ext test
stmt: Authors get MockHost from the real api.lock.json, JSONL session scripts, golden images per backend, access-tree check on every surface, budget assertions.

title: Transactions, modal scopes and groups
stmt: Plugins edit documents through detached transaction logs with touch-set merge and graft, off-owner replay, live-writer and commit leases, modal scopes, groups, coalescing and show_working.

title: T1 bindings, live controls and lazy

title: Canvas layers, regions and view

title: HDR viewer presentation
stmt: A viewer node with hdr:true presents extended range (EDR, scRGB, Wayland color-management-v1), reports hdrHeadroom from host.displays and tone-maps on SDR.

title: Unified input events
stmt: Identical input events for T1 controls, T2 regions, T4 and L4(c) viewers: down, drag, up, cancel (capture lost), click, hover, key_down, key_up, modifiers_changed, wheel, magnify, rotate, pan2, smart_zoom, with modifiers, buttons, clicks, pointer_kind, at and at_doc.

stmt: Image, animated, video and audio nodes decoded by craft-media at UI volume with zero guest calls; time=host:time.playhead follows the playhead; offscreen media shows its poster.

budget: provisional raw stroke in the frame of its sample, whatever the filter time

stmt: text-field regions give a host-drawn, host-edited field at a document or screen.

title: T3 host editors
stmt: Host editors (curve, gradient, colour wheel, node graph, timeline lanes, key graph, path, meter, scope) fed by plugin models or rings, with state machines in ui-editors-core and host-side edit keys.

title: T4 image and texture viewer
stmt: Viewer of image, texture or surface handles with host zoom, pan.

title: T5a remote surface
stmt: A native or web helper renders into a shared texture the host composites, clipped and z-ordered, forwarding pointer, focused keys, IME and scroll; a helper that stops presenting freezes with a not-responding strip.

title: T5b helper-owned OS window
stmt: Helper-owned OS window that the broker parents (addChildWindow, owner HWND, xdg-foreign), clamps to the host floating level and marks with an identity strip; occlusion is checked before any trust sheet takes input.

title: T6 web window
stmt: Web window on CEF in the app's one craft-plugin-web with per-plugin request context, CSP, craft-pkg and craft-picked schemes and the __sync endpoint; placed per web-mode@1.

title: Time-indexed overlays

stmt: UI 1.4 adds curve, gradient, color-wheel, meter, scope, viewer, thumbnail, angle.

title: UI 1.5 widget set

title: Web worker backend
stmt: One Web Worker per package in a sandboxed cross-origin iframe (CSP none, COOP/COEP); SAB arenas and an Atomics ring link it to a shim in the iframe's agent cluster; page and shim pass transferable ArrayBuffers; the page never blocks (Atomics.waitAsync).

stmt: app.executeCommand(id) and app.findMenuCommandId(name) map through generated aecommands.json to EffectCraft commands with fixed params and run through the gate; an unmapped name returns 0 and an unmapped id throws -8 Unsupported {AeCommand}. AEGP_DoCommand, CEP evalScript and KBar share the table.

title: Paste After Effects keyframe data
stmt: Clipboard After Effects Keyframe Data pastes onto the selected layer or property (Transform, effect properties, Mask Shape, time remap) honouring Units Per Second, source size and pixel aspect; host parser, one undo step, visible to plugins through the paste intercept.

title: AEGP general plugins
stmt: AEGP plugins run in the aehost helper; hooks map to commands, intercepts and timers; each run is one transaction.

title: AE plugin discovery
stmt: The sandboxed helper parses PiPL in picked folders; each effect becomes a synthesised raster.filter@2 native contribution, risk L3; all effects of one binary signer in one plug-in folder form one synthesised package.

stmt: appl_id 'FXTC'; reported versions derive from suite table coverage.

title: AE param, pixel and MFR mapping
stmt: PF params map to ParamKind@2 keeping match names; worlds map to arena views or shared textures; MFR flag picks concurrency.

title: aehost process model
stmt: One helper per host group, kept loaded while any open document holds one of its instances and reaped 60 s after the last closes; restricted, no network; native.full needs L4 consent; strikes apply.

title: Sequence data under MFR
stmt: Render threads read a versioned read-only copy of sequence data; mutable render data is a private copy never saved.

title: AE session selectors edit the document
stmt: Session selectors edit a forked working snapshot as app.batch steps: owner edits never block, commit rebases (conflict rolls back with a notice); non-window selectors past 2 s show Stop; Stop or a trap rolls back; render.request inside renders the snapshot.

title: Renders from AE UI selectors

title: aehost Windows file access, windows, textures

title: Behaviour hooks

title: Expression determinism
stmt: random, gaussRandom, seedRandom, wiggle and noise are shared seeded natives, identical on every evaluator; transcendental Math functions may differ by one ulp between engines.

title: Expression evaluation to values
stmt: expr.eval {props, times} returns export values for exporters to bake. Plugin id's expr.set with a dependency closure past its document.read scope returns -2 {needs}. Renders and exports always use current values; expr.eval, reads, job reads and render.request or render.frame output reaching plugin id past scope also return it. A user edit widening its effect param closure is a grant on its sheet.

title: Frame batches
stmt: Per frame the host sends one batch {generation, times, props} covering t, look-ahead t+1..t+8 and motion-blur sub-frames; the worker evaluates the dependency graph lazily with memo per (property, time) and returns a columnar value table with discovered dependencies.
budget: 1 IPC round trip per frame batch; batch reply <=4 ms p95 for a 200-layer rig at 1080p30 (reference machine)

title: Expression host faults
stmt: A worker crash or hang is a host fault: the broker restarts it; meanwhile untainted batches use expr-boa, tainted ones hold the last correct frame, preview fill and exports wait. A batch crashing the worker twice is poisoned: its properties show the named error, exports end with it, and its ExprOrigin plugin takes one strike.

title: ext-expr host process
stmt: Desktop: one craft-plugin-worker role expr per app process (sandboxed; no files, network, exec, package or grants; allow-jit) with one V8 isolate per render thread sharing the read-only ExprScene, so parallel renders evaluate concurrently. Web: a sandboxed cross-origin Web Worker on QuickJS.

title: Interactive misses hold last correct frame
stmt: In drags, scrubs and seeks the render thread sends a priority batch and waits within CallClass::ExprBridge; past it untainted batches use expr-boa, tainted ones hold the last correct frame, and a newer pointer sample's batch supersedes older ones, so a pose is never wrong.
budget: priority batch for a 200-layer tainted rig <=4 ms p95; <=5% held frames in a 2 s drag (reference machine)

title: Library update in project
stmt: Updating the plugin offers 'Update library in this project' as an undoable edit; embedded source stays evaluable with the plugin uninstalled.

title: Expression limits
stmt: rewrite.rs counters at loop back-edges and function entries enforce the boa limits (LOOP_LIMIT, recursion 400, MAX_DEPTH, MAX_RUNS) identically on every evaluator; each evaluation also has a 256 MiB heap and a wall budget. A breach deterministically fails that property with its pre-expression value and a named error.

title: Expression memo
stmt: Memo keyed by expression source hash, property, time, each recorded dependency's generation and each sampled region's content key; a commit invalidates only properties whose dependencies the ChangeSet touched. It is the app's LRU expression cache, not a plugin account.

title: Expression origin tracking
stmt: The gate sets Plugin(id) when a plugin origin writes an expression (expr.set, app.batch, ExtendScript, preset or .ffx apply, CEP evalScript) or the user applies a .ffx, preset or pack that sinks::fs::provenance marks plugin-shipped or plugin-written. Copy, paste, precompose, save and partial user edits keep it; only replacing the whole source or Make this expression mine, after its disclaimer, sets User.

title: Preview fill and export wait
stmt: RAM preview fill and final renders wait for every expression batch, bounded only by the expression and fn() limits, so cached and exported frames carry current values; Skip Frames playback drops a frame whose tainted batch misses instead of showing it.

title: sampleImage pixel path
stmt: layer.sampleImage(point, radius, postEffect, t) suspends the property; the host renders the region on the frame's render thread through nested render_request (a dependent layer gives After Effects' cycle error) and resumes with averaged RGBA f32, memoised by content key, rect and post_effect.

title: ExprScene image
stmt: The host publishes an ExprScene in an ext-shm segment the worker maps read-only: columnar layers, keys, values, markers, text, comp settings and parsed .json/.csv/.tsv footage for every open or reachable comp; a computed comp() miss returns SceneMiss and is added within the frame budget.
budget: delta of <=100 props published <=0.5 ms p95 before the next batch on a 2,000-layer project; full build on open <=200 ms; segment <=64 MB plus parsed data footage

title: UI thread never evaluates expressions
stmt: Effect Controls readouts and Graph Editor curves read the memo for shown times and request misses; the UI thread never evaluates an expression.

title: ExtendScript runtime
stmt: extendscript@1 runs AE scripts and ScriptUI panels on the worker JIT.

title: Farm submission by picked folder
stmt: file.collect writes a job file and project copy into a picked farm folder under the project plugin lock.

title: After Effects .ffx preset import
stmt: applyPreset(File), Import and anim.applyPreset accept .ffx, parsed in the confined craft-media-decode helper (fuzz target ffx_parse) into resource.preset@1 (effects by match name, values, eased keys, expressions, masks, text animators); unknown match names stay missing-effect placeholders. Animation Composer and Motion Bro packs apply unchanged.

title: fn() call mechanisms
stmt: fn() calls avoid a round trip each: memo-first lookup in the expr_bake table; each render-thread isolate has its own ring to its own pure-function instance on a dedicated thread in the plugin's worker, so a miss costs one round trip and plugin jobs or parallel renders never block it; look-ahead prefetch includes motion-blur sub-frames.
budget: memo hit <=1 us; miss one ring round trip <=20 us p99; parallel export <=1x AE MFR time

title: Format import and render output
stmt: Importers return frames, layers or project fragments; output formats encode ordered frames into the lent folder.

title: Former refusals routed
stmt: Request sheets and named permissions replace old refusals.

title: Per-frame order and output validation
stmt: Plan, budgeted inputs, then gpu or render; output finite-checked and clamped to max_result.

title: fx.apply budget charging
stmt: Callee time is charged to the outer CallClass; over budget FxFail::Degrade per externalrender@2.

title: Running built-in effects
stmt: Any built-in runs from a plugin: Pure ones via fx.apply; time, layer, audio or stateful ones via a nested render.request with insert: EffectInsert at the caller's CallClass; both charged to the caller frame.

title: Generated WGSL modules (gpu.compile)
stmt: One generated WGSL module per graph region, validated like shaders; cache sized by the plugin memory account (LRU by bytes), validated modules persisted on disk by IR digest and warmed at enable.

title: Glide features
stmt: Glide gives users an ease curve editor with presets, apply to selected keys, ease copy and paste, and sampled custom shapes beyond bezier.

title: GT3 gpu.api tier
stmt: Recorded command lists validated against IR, quotas and ownership, recorded into the walk once promoted; needs gpu.direct.

title: Asynchronous generated pipeline compile
stmt: Generated pipelines compile async; preview shows the previous result degraded, export waits.

title: Device loss recovery keeping the session
stmt: Recovery keeps the Session: plugin GPU resources are invalidated and re-initialised, SimCache falls back to CPU or disk checkpoints, interop slots and fences are re-shared to live helpers, the suspect is struck.

title: Plugin GPU errors attributed to the plugin
stmt: Plugin GPU errors are attributed to the plugin, never the app.

title: GT1 gpu.kernel tier
stmt: Per-pixel WGSL cook(); the host binds and fuses adjacent kernels.

title: GT2 gpu.pass tier
stmt: A manifest DAG of compute and render passes validated per stage and scheduled by ext-gpu.

title: GPU timestamps feed the cost model
stmt: Timestamp queries feed the plugin cost model.

title: Helper timeout and death handling
stmt: On helper timeout or death the host signals the fence, retires slots and strikes; the frame gets FxFail::Degrade per externalrender@2, uncached.

title: GT4 viewport GPU tier
stmt: Overlay and renderer3d@1 passes depth-test in comp camera space.

title: GPU plugins on headless export device
stmt: Headless export runs the same plugin GPU graphs.

stmt: Hush features via the listed realisers.

title: Isolate features
stmt: Isolate features via the listed realisers.

stmt: Expression rigs of the Duik, Rubberhose, Ease and Wizz and Joysticks 'n Sliders class run at JIT speed on ext-expr; plugin-tainted expressions never evaluate in the app process and are never presented stale.

title: js.plugin@1 modern JS/TS plugins
stmt: js.plugin@1 runs JS and TypeScript on the worker JIT engine (V8; QuickJS on web) with eval kept and the Rust op surface: @craft/effectcraft bindings, @craft/ui T1 trees, @craft/fx typed arrays over arena views, hot loops <=2x UXP V8, Node modules via @craft/node-compat.

title: JavaScript and TypeScript plugins

stmt: Host displace, ST-map and mesh-warp kernels.

stmt: Host pyramid and radial blur kernels.

title: Plugin adjustment layers
stmt: Plugin adjustment layers (adjust.point@1) bake a native-space lattice, re-bake within BUDGETS[SliderPreview], add one undo step and evaluate directly where the lattice misses tolerance.
detail: Adjustment::Plugin {stamp, params, lut} runs the GT1 kernel or Wasm entry and composites like Color Lookup. Lattices: RGB 8/16 33^3 or 65^3; RGB 32 log2 shaper into 65^3, unclipped; Lab 65^3; CMYK 17^4 to 33^4; Gray and Duotone 1D 4,096; Multichannel per-plane 1D if separable; none in Indexed or Bitmap. Tolerance 1/1024, CMYK deltaE <=0.5. In every mode, misses (threshold, posterize), out-of-range values and non-separable Multichannel run the GT1 kernel in the compositor; Wasm-only plugins evaluate per tile on the render worker within BUDGETS[RenderHook], cached by layer key; a miss or trap shows the last lattice with a stale badge, a trap also striking.

title: Argent features
stmt: Argent: black-and-white conversion with film emulations, grain, toning and on-canvas control points for local brightness, contrast and structure.
detail: Wasm SIMD plus native kernel.* CPU path and GT1/GT2 GPU path in all modes and depths; overlay handles and labels for points; durable smart-filter output. A second 8bf build runs through craft-pshost from a picked folder as a scriptable smart filter with a native T5 dialog.

title: brush.dab@1 custom tips and dab shaders
stmt: A dab plugin renders coverage (optionally colour and depth) of one Dab plus the pen sample, as a GT1 tip kernel the host runs per dab or a Wasm entry called per frame; spacing, texture, dynamics, wet edges and mixer stay the app's.
name: brush.dab@1

title: brush.engine@1 whole brush engines
stmt: brush.engine@1 takes the PenSample stream, params, canvas and a stroke buffer and emits dabs, Wasm CPU tiles or gpu simulation; final pixels are the plugin's.
name: brush.engine@1
detail: Wasm dab entries and engines target BUDGETS[PenSample]; an over-budget call is a missed frame, tile engines may yield across calls, and the epoch trap fires at the 8-frame bound. After a trap or 8 missed frames the stroke rolls back, the engine is struck and badged 'Paused: <engine> too slow', and journaled samples allow Re-run. A provisional outline draws after two missed frames. Commit is paint.plugin {engine, brush, samples, seed}, replayable from Actions. Presets name 'plugin.<pkg>/<engine>'; .pcbrush packs carry engines. Without a GPU the optional Wasm entry runs as tiles, else the brush shows 'Needs GPU'.

title: GPU brush engine bindings
stmt: GPU brush engines (emits = gpu) run GT3 programs on craft_gpu with sparse state, no readback until stroke end, seeded replay and watchdog rollback.
detail: emits = gpu declares a GT2 DAG or GT3 program validated at load; each submit binds samples, params, plugin state (persist stroke or layer, the latter a plugin-data tile tree in the replay digest), a read-only sparse canvas view and a paged out texture with a dirty-page bitmap.

title: Brush engine targets and modes
stmt: Brush engines emitting dabs, tiles or gpu paint layer masks, alpha, spot, Quick Mask, CMYK, Lab and Multichannel targets.
detail: target {kind: layer|layer_mask|filter_mask|alpha|spot|quick_mask, mode, depth}. The stroke buffer, brush.dab@1 included, is RGBA16F for U8 targets and RGBA32F for U16 and F32, converted to native at composite and commit. Masks, alpha, spot and Quick Mask take Gray coverage; other modes convert through craft-cms (Multichannel paints the active plane); Indexed re-maps with dither; Bitmap thresholds at 128 or dithers.

title: GPU brush replay
stmt: Replay from recorded samples and seed: bit-exact on one adapter, deltaE <=1 across.

title: GPU brush scheduling
stmt: One Slot::Paint submit per frame; probation digests ink a frame late behind the outline; samples fold, never drop; stroke end reads back dirty pages once.
budget: Paint within GpuSubmit; ink <=1 frame promoted

title: Paged brush state
stmt: State and out are PagedTexture 256x256 pages allocated under the batch footprint and charged per page; over quota, clean pages evict first, then dirty pages outside the footprint spill by Background readback of at most 8 pages per frame; a stroke never fails.
budget: 512 KiB per page; 0 mid-stroke readbacks under quota

Oilworks and Grainbox hold lane 0 at frame + 4 ms p99 for every n, copies within 2 frames; after 3 missed frames copies drop for that stroke.

detail: Targets: layer, layer and filter masks, vector-mask raster, colour, spot and alpha channels, Quick Mask, selection, composites, smart-object source. Native forms: RGB and Gray U8/U16/F32 (F32 linear, unclamped); CMYK+spot U8/U16 ink coverage; Lab U8/U16 (U16 0..32768, a and b neutral 16384); Multichannel and Duotone U8/U16; Indexed U8 plus palette (writes re-map with dither, or convert:true switches to RGB in the same transaction); Bitmap U8 0/255 (threshold 128 unless dither). Other PixelSpaces convert with craft-cms and the document colour settings inside the tile copy.

title: pshost data path and failures
stmt: Bands of every mode and depth cross a shared arena in FilterRecord form, outData commits through pixels.write in one transaction, scriptable 8bf filters run as smart filters, and crashes and hangs of any module roll back.
detail: Form: U8 and F32 as is, U16 scaled to 0..32768 and back, Lab as is, CMYK inverted, Gray, Multichannel and Duotone a plane per channel, Indexed with the palette in the LUTs, Bitmap 1 bit packed; unchanged samples keep native values. Descriptors replay silently; double-click reopens the vendor dialog with the recorded descriptor. Only the originating document is busy. Progress and abort procs drive host progress and Cancel. A crash, or Stop plug-in (on Cancel or 10 s without polls or brokered-device I/O, killing after 2 s grace), rolls back the call or doc.build and strikes the plug-in; a crash names its error. Writes to picked support folders and OS preference paths go to a per-plug-in overlay in its private folder, kept until revoke; concurrent processes merge their layers at exit, newest file wins. notice.native_host covers offline activation; the network stays denied.

PICA: ActionControl, ActionDescriptor, ActionReference, ActionList, BasicActionControl, UIHooks (MainAppWindow gives the T5b parent), ColorSpace, Handle, Buffer, ChannelPorts, ASZString, Error; others return kSPSuiteNotFoundError, logged. Grants: 8BFM document.edit at the invoking scope, selection.write, document.read:document; 8BIF and 8BYM picked file, document.create, document.read:document if they write; 8BEM document.read, picked target; 8BAM document.create (+devices.usb:picked); 8BSM selection.write, document.read:document; 8BCM none; 8LIZ document.edit:all, document.create, document.lifecycle, app.scripts. Play and Get map through photocraft-psdesc to app.batch and typed reads, admitted as principal pshost.<class id>; out-of-grant events fail with PsHostError::Denied naming 4CC and permission, errPlugInHostInsufficient to the plug-in, and permissions.request on the next gesture.

title: Savepoints inside scripts and modals

detail: activeHistoryState, historyStates and batchPlay get on historyState return committed states followed by the run's savepoints named from psdesc::record; snapshots made inside the run become History-panel snapshots at commit; selecting a savepoint restores the working snapshot and truncates TxnLog with no history step, no owner hop and no history.control grant, and the commit stays one undo step; selecting a state older than the base commits the open transaction, runs navigation as its own host step under history.control:navigate and continues in a fresh transaction with the same label.

stmt: Features of FLG-PC-sheetkit.

title: Smart filter durable output
stmt: Durable smart-filter output is shared without copy, untouched by previews, saved by changed tiles and kept byte-identical in PSD.
detail: smartFilters.pluginResult = full (default) | proxy | ask, the last two user choices only. DurableOutput::Full is an Arc to the spillable full-resolution tile tree; a full commit swaps Arc and key (stamp, params, source and mask digests); a key mismatch at open renders with a stale badge. Save writes LZ4 chunks in .pcd for changed tiles, compacting on Save As. PSD/PSB write the composite, the plugin record in a private plgn block and the filterFX entry for hosted 8bf; TIFF writes the composite. Export uses the live plugin, else durable output with a notice; a user-chosen proxy exports only after 'Export with lower-resolution saved result'.

title: Smart filter with plugin dispatch
stmt: SmartFilter {command, params, blend, opacity, visible, plugin: Option<PluginStamp>, durable} dispatches plugin.* commands under the stamp's contract and maps filterFX entries of hosted 8bf filters both ways.
detail: PluginStamp {id, version, sha256, contribution, determinism}; hosted 8bf filters key by PiPL class id and name; their version is PiPL vers, else file version, else a new sha256 is newer, compatible while the class id holds. A newer compatible version re-renders from the recorded params after one confirm per document and updates the stamp. A missing, quarantined, disabled or older plugin renders durable output with one prompt, never pass-through, badged 'not installed', 'quarantined', 'disabled' or 'needs <version> or newer'. Unknown built-in ids render the stored composite with badge 'Filter <name> is not supported'.

title: Slow smart-filter re-render as job
stmt: Slow or unsampled smart-filter re-renders run as jobs behind proxy or stale output and swap durable output once.
detail: CostEma (cost per megapixel by stamp, exec path, mode and depth) is seeded at open from the cost saved with the durable output. A re-render predicted over BUDGETS[RenderHook], or with no sample, becomes a background Job on the plugin's account with progress, Cancel and a 'Rendering' badge, showing proxy or stale output meanwhile. Completion swaps the tile tree in one owner hop, no undo step; a newer edit restarts it; Cancel keeps stale output with Re-render. Save never waits, flagging stale output; open re-queues its job. Export and print wait with progress.
budget: Proxy or stale within 1 frame; UI p99 <=1 vsync during the job
